reviewBasis: Exact 55 fictional exchanges explicitly approved in the owner-provided dialogue-expansion request. No Scripture verification is asserted.

entries.opponent: Behold! The full might of Rome standeth behind me!
entries.judah: If you represent the Might of Rome, Rome is weaker than I thought, Come get this work!

entries.opponent: For twenty winters have I trained to defeat warriors such as thee!
entries.judah: You waited 20 years to cash in this whoopin' you about to get? You shoulda been a doctor.

entries.opponent: Mine helmet was forged to withstand the mightiest blows!
entries.judah: It's about to be forged with this blade of steel, come get this work!

entries.opponent: Caesar hath chosen me as his greatest champion!
entries.judah: Well, Caesar done chose wrong.

entries.opponent: Ten thousand soldiers shall avenge my defeat!
entries.judah: Defeat? You already giving up?

entries.opponent: None hath ever survived my mighty blade!
entries.judah: There's a first time for everything.

entries.opponent: Thou shalt never make it to the Kingdom!
entries.judah: I wouldn't bet your life on that!

entries.opponent: I bear the royal seal of Caesar himself!
entries.judah: Tell Caesar he stamped the wrong man.

entries.opponent: My name is feared throughout every province!
entries.judah: Then why'd you have to introduce yourself?

entries.opponent: No soul hath crossed this bridge and lived!
entries.judah: Sounds like you been counting wrong.

entries.opponent: The earth trembleth beneath my feet!
entries.judah: Nah, that's your knees.

entries.opponent: I was born to conquer warriors such as thee!
entries.judah: That's a rough day to find out you weren't.

entries.opponent: The gates shall never open for thee!
entries.judah: Then why you standing in front of 'em?

entries.opponent: I shall crush thee beneath my boot!
entries.judah: Keep that foot planted. Makes you easier to hit.

entries.opponent: Mine shield hath never been broken!
entries.judah: So you're due.

entries.opponent: Lay down thy weapon and beg for mercy!
entries.judah: You first.

entries.opponent: I have guarded this passage for thirty winters!
entries.judah: Thirty years? Man, take a day off.

entries.opponent: I shall strike before thine eyes can blink!
entries.judah: You might wanna start before my eyes roll.

entries.opponent: Thou art beneath my notice!
entries.judah: Then why you talking to me?

entries.opponent: My sword is as swift as lightning!
entries.judah: And your mouth slow as molasses. Pick a speed.

entries.opponent: I am the final trial before the Kingdom!
entries.judah: Then this oughta be quick.

entries.opponent: I fear no man who draweth breath!
entries.judah: Good. Don't start now.

entries.opponent: Thy confidence shall bury thee!
entries.judah: You got a shovel? Better start digging.

entries.opponent: Rome hath never bowed to any man!
entries.judah: I ain't here to negotiate with Rome. Just you.

entries.opponent: Thy blade shall shatter upon mine armor!
entries.judah: We can test that. Hold still.

entries.opponent: I stand as a wall between thee and thy destiny!
entries.judah: Then get ready to be a doorway.

entries.opponent: My skill was forged in fire and blood!
entries.judah: You talk like it came with a warranty.

entries.opponent: I shall make thy name a warning!
entries.judah: Make sure you spell it right.

entries.opponent: Behold! I command a thousand spears!
entries.judah: Then why you sweating over one sword?

entries.opponent: Thy end is written in the dust!
entries.judah: Funny. All I see is your footprints going backward.

entries.opponent: Though I stagger, Rome shall not fall!
entries.judah: Rome might not. You definitely about to.

entries.opponent: My strength hath scarcely waned!
entries.judah: Then why you leaning on that spear?

entries.opponent: I shall yet strike thee down!
entries.judah: Then quit promising and start swinging.

entries.opponent: One more blow cannot undo me!
entries.judah: Good thing that's all I got left.

entries.opponent: These wounds are nothing!
entries.judah: Then stop checking 'em.

entries.opponent: Behold, I remain standing!
entries.judah: For now.

entries.opponent: Though my knees tremble, my courage faileth not!
entries.judah: Well, tell your courage to come help your knees!

entries.opponent: Thou hast but one life remaining!
entries.judah: And you still ain't finished? That's embarrassing.

entries.opponent: Four blows have I dealt thee, and yet thou resistest!
entries.judah: Four blows and I'm still talking.

entries.opponent: Thy next mistake shall be thy last!
entries.judah: Then you better not make yours.

entries.opponent: No shield can save thee now!
entries.judah: Never asked it to.

entries.opponent: Thou tremblest at thy final hour!
entries.judah: That's the ground. Check your footing.

entries.opponent: Even thy strength hath abandoned thee!
entries.judah: Funny. My sword's still here.

entries.opponent: Thou shalt beg for mercy!
entries.judah: You practicing your own speech?

entries.opponent: I cannot fall! I am Rome's finest!
entries.judah: Then they need a new finest.

entries.opponent: This cannot be mine end!
entries.judah: Shoulda read the signs.

entries.opponent: My sword hath failed me!
entries.judah: Nah. You failed your sword.

entries.opponent: Caesar shall hear of this!
entries.judah: Tell him to send somebody ready.

entries.opponent: I was promised victory!
entries.judah: Somebody done told you wrong.

entries.opponent: I yield! Spare me this shame!
entries.judah: Then quit making a scene.

entries.opponent: By whose strength dost thou stand before this gate?
entries.judah: The Most High brought me this far.

entries.opponent: What light guideth thee when darkness surroundeth thee?
entries.judah: The word of the Most High. Open the gate.

entries.opponent: What remaineth when sword and shield fail thee?
entries.judah: Faith. And the word I was taught.

entries.opponent: Thou seekest a Kingdom which thine eyes have not seen.
entries.judah: I walk by faith. Now move.

entries.opponent: Art thou prepared to endure beyond this gate?
entries.judah: As long as the Most High gives me breath.
